# Charlie Sloane

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlie Sloane is a boy characterized by his distinctive goggle eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023)_

## Personality

Charlie Sloane is an ambitious individual with a clear long-term ambition. He aspires to enter politics and successfully secure a seat as a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

Charlie Sloane was a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at school. He was among the peers present when the advanced class was organized by Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, putting him alongside fellow pupils such as [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md).
